description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the enterprise security foundation for an AI agent platform used in advanced engineering workflows. As a senior, hands-on individual contributor reporting to the CTO, you will shape the security architecture and personally ship controls across the agent runtime, desktop application, backend services, and engineering integrations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the threat model and security roadmap by mapping trust boundaries, prioritizing risks, and defining testable acceptance criteria.

 - Secure agent execution with sandboxing, approval controls, policy enforcement, and scoped capabilities for tools, generated code, and application actions.

 - Build secure service boundaries, credential handling, enterprise identity integrations, tenant isolation, and controls for network access, storage, retention, and deletion.

 - Create auditable action records and approval evidence, and ensure sensitive operations fail safely when required controls or services are unavailable.

 - Harden desktop deployment, integrations, packaging, updates, and releases, including customer-hosted and restricted-network environments.

 - Develop adversarial and integration tests, investigate vulnerabilities, maintain release security checks, and support incident response and customer security reviews.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Four to ten years of engineering experience, including at least one year in security software engineering securing desktop applications or similar products.

 - Experience owning complex production systems through design, implementation, rollout, and maintenance, with substantial personally shipped code and security controls.

 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, operating systems, and systems design.

 - Experience translating threat models into enforceable code and tests for authorization, secrets, process isolation, permissions, network boundaries, or secure execution.

 - Ability to debug privileged behavior across processes and operating-system boundaries, and assess AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, hostile tool inputs, and untrusted model output.

 - Relevant experience may include AI agent runtimes, developer tools, tool protocols, Python, TypeScript, Rust, desktop security, enterprise identity, or customer-hosted deployments.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $330,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Full-time, on-site in San Francisco, California.
